readmeExcerpt: This demo application streams news articles as events from a REST API, processing those articles and storing them in a multimodal database that includes relational, document, event, and vector data types.
highlights: OJDBC_PATH: Path to the directory containing your ojdbc.properties file. I use the ojdbc.properties file in [src/test/resources](./src/test/resources).
metaTitle: News Event Streaming Application | Oracle AI Database Code Samples
metaDescription: Spring Boot application that ingests news events, stores them in Oracle AI Database, and supports vector search.
